title: French Poached Salmon with Sweet Glaze
description: A simple yet elegant French dish featuring poached salmon with a sweet and sticky glaze.
instructions: Preheat the water for poaching to 145°F (63°C).
Poach the salmon fillet for 8-10 minutes or until cooked through.
In a small saucepan, combine honey, lemon juice, and garlic.
Bring the mixture to a simmer over medium heat and cook for 2-3 minutes or until slightly thickened.
Add the quick sugar to the saucepan and stir to combine.
Strain the glaze through a fine-mesh sieve into a bowl, pressing on the solids to extract all the liquid.
Serve the poached salmon with the sweet glaze spooned over the top.
